Selective demolition cleanup.basis: Per sf of demo zone; Rough clean of entire building ($0.08-0.22, ~350 sf/hr) slowed by heavier debris and retained-finish protection; $42/hr cleaner

Interior gut-out cleanup.basis: Per sf of shell; Rough clean of entire building plus Bulk debris pickup by floor and slab scraping; hauling/containers extra

Post-demolition dust and debris removal.basis: Per sf; Rough clean of entire building and Rough clean of plenum (overhead HEPA) analogs; wet/HEPA silica methods at $42-55/hr

Fire and flood reconstruction cleanup.basis: Per sf; above Rough clean of entire building, below Fire and smoke residue cleaning ($2-8/sf, restoration scope); mix of $42 cleaner and $55 tech

Hurricane and storm reconstruction clean.basis: Per sf interior; Rough clean of entire building plus Roof debris removal and sediment handling; heavy exterior debris better priced by load (Final haul-off)

Post-abatement cleaning.basis: Per sf of released area; Negative air zone final cleaning ($0.12-0.35, 220 sf/hr) at licensed/certified tech rate ~$55-70/hr; excludes abatement

Historic building restoration cleanup.basis: Per sf; Rough clean/final interior analogs slowed for test areas and gentle methods; $55-70/hr tech, lead-safe practices

Post-construction duct cleaning.basis: Per lf of duct; HVAC duct interior cleaning ($3-10/lf, 15 lf/hr) source removal per NADCA ACR methods; AHUs priced separately

Ventilation commissioning cleaning.basis: Per air handler or fan unit incl. coils, pans and plenum; between Air handler exterior cleaning ($40-150) and Air handler interior cleaning ($350-1,500); ~6.5 tech-hr at $55-70

Indoor air quality testing coordination.basis: Per test event: scheduling, pre-sampling detail clean and access control (~8 hr at $55); analog Low-VOC product log and Pre-fire marshal inspection clean; testing fees by independent firm excluded

Elevator shaft and hoistway cleanup.basis: Per hoistway stop incl. sill, ledges and wall within reach; Elevator door and sill track cleaning ($15-45) plus share of Elevator pit debris removal ($75-300); elevator mechanic fees extra

Controlled-environment final decontamina.basis: Per sf; Cleanroom protocol cleaning ($0.75-3.00, 30 sf/hr) with added final passes and logging; $70/hr specialist; consumables extra

Post-construction odor removal.basis: Per sf; Disinfection service ($0.05-0.25, 500 sf/hr) and Owner walkthrough prep clean analogs; source cleaning, fragrance-free products, $42/hr

Environmental verification preparation.basis: Per sf of test area; Negative air zone final cleaning ($0.12-0.35, 220 sf/hr) at $55/hr tech plus access control; testing excluded

Precast concrete cleaning.basis: Per sf of facade; between Building facade washing ($0.15-0.60) and Brick and masonry cleaning ($0.40-1.20); $70/hr specialist; lift or swing stage extra

Architectural metal cleaning.basis: Per sf; Stainless and metal wall panel cleaning ($0.20-0.70, 120 sf/hr) and Metal panel and canopy cleaning; $55/hr tech; film removal and lift extra

Sensitive historic masonry cleaning.basis: Per sf; Brick and masonry cleaning ($0.40-1.20) slowed to Masonry efflorescence removal pace (45 sf/hr) for test patches and low-pressure methods; $70/hr specialist
